name: artisans-house-desert
description: Artisan's House, the desert look (ROADMAP 49.10g): the shipped Kiln House drawn again for a hot dry village, a flat-roofed sandstone and mud-brick house with an iwan porch, a domed terracotta updraft kiln smoking beside it and the roof a shaded drying floor for greenware.
